summaries.text:
Amends the Agricultural Act of 1949 and the Agricultural Adjustment Act of 1938 to terminate sugarcane and sugar beet price support, marketing quota, and acreage allotment programs on the date the President certifies to the Congress that a General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade has been entered into that prohibits all sugar export subsidies, price support and production adjustment programs, and other sugar import trade barriers.

Makes related amendments to the Commodity Credit Corporation Charter Act and the Food Security Act of 1985.
